name: PLaMo 3 Translate (0.8B / 2B / 8B / 31B)

lineage.base_model: PLaMo 3 NICT (PFN and NICT joint pretraining)
lineage.how_derived: further training on tens of billions of tokens of translation-focused data (card)

purpose: Translation-specialized LLM that the builder says delivers world-class translation quality, strongest on Japanese-English; takes surrounding context, previous translation pairs and a glossary, and selects plain or polite Japanese (card).

license.name: PLaMo Community License
license.notes: License text page (plamo.preferredai.jp) is rendered by script and could not be read; only the card summary was read: personal and non-commercial use free without registration; commercial use free after a registration form when revenue/sales of the user and affiliates is 1 billion yen or less; above that a separate agreement with PFN is required. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: dense transformer (Plamo3ForCausalLM, custom code), 31B config read
architecture.gguf_arch: plamo3 (name from config model_type; llama.cpp GGUF repos are published by the vendor)
architecture.attention: GQA 64 heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128; sliding-window layers (window 2048, pattern 8) mixed with full attention (YaRN rope)

pc-12gb.notes: 5.3 GB; 31B Q4 (19.5 GB) would need RAM offload

pc-16gb.notes: 31B Q4_K_M 19.5 GB only with partial RAM offload (dense, slow)

pc-24gb.notes: 19.5 GB plus KV cache is tight

mac-16-24gb.notes: 31B Q4 does not fit the 12/22 GB GPU share with context

mac-32gb.notes: 31B Q4 19.5 GB against about 22 GB GPU share

engine_support.notes: Card lists llama.cpp as engine for the GGUF format and says llama.cpp adds BOS itself; not tested by us.

benchmarks.name: FLORES+ chrF++ En<->14 languages (avg both directions)
FLORES+ chrF++ Ja<->14 languages (avg both directions)

strengths: Card quantization tables show Q4_K_M within about 0.1 chrF++ of BF16 at every size
Context, history and glossary inputs; Japanese politeness control
Size spread of 8B vs 31B is small on the builder's metrics (56.22 vs 56.61 chrF++ En)
weaknesses: GGUF Q2_K loses 0.45 to 3.3 chrF++ depending on size (card)
Vendor benchmarks only; comparison figure is an image against TranslateGemma and HY-MT2 chosen by the builder
Prompt format PFML3 recommended for production instead of chat template
soft.maturity: Preferred Networks with NICT; weights released 2026-10 with BF16, FP8, W4A16, W4AFP8, NVFP4, GGUF and MLX variants for every size.

tona_fit.reason: Small gap between 8B and 31B on the builder's numbers makes the 8B (5.3 GB at Q4) a strong small-class translator for every hardware class. No German-specific numbers from the builder.

sources.note: page did not render license text without script
